title: Buck converter cooling chain
description:
Design the cooling for a synchronous buck converter: Vin = 24 V, Vout = 5 V, Iout = 15 A. Both MOSFETs are identical: Rds(on) = 3.42 mOhm at 25 C with temperature coefficient alpha = 0.0052 per C, i.e. Rds(Tj) = Rds25 * (1 + alpha * (Tj - 25)); switching transition tr + tf = 51 ns; gate charge Qg = 73 nC at Vgs = 10 V. Use this loss model: P_cond = Iout^2 * Rds(Tj) (the two FETs together conduct the full output current), P_sw = 0.5 * Vin * Iout * (tr + tf) * fsw, P_gate = 2 * Qg * Vgs * fsw, P = P_cond + P_sw + P_gate. Efficiency eta = Pout / (Pout + P) with Pout = Vout * Iout.

Both FETs share one heat sink: Tj = Ta + P * (RthJC + RthCS + Rsa), with RthJC = 0.55 C/W, RthCS = 0.38 C/W, Ta = 35 C inside the enclosure. Note Rds depends on Tj, so solve the thermal loop self-consistently. Rsa depends on the air velocity v through the sink; interpolate linearly between the catalog points and clamp outside them. Air velocity v = Q / 3600 / A_duct with A_duct = 0.0057 m2, where Q (m3/h) is the fan operating point: the flow at which the fan's static pressure (interpolate linearly between its curve points) equals the enclosure system curve dP = k * Q^2 with k = 0.0127 Pa/(m3/h)^2. With no fan, v = 0.

Ripple: inductor L = 11.2 uH, output capacitor C = 136 uF, D = Vout / Vin. dI = Vout * (1 - D) / (L * fsw) must not exceed 3.75 A and dV = dI / (8 * C * fsw) must not exceed 150 mV.

Constraints: fsw between 50 and 500 kHz; Tj <= 115 C; eta >= 97.5%; fan noise <= 40 dBA (no fan = 0 dBA); heat sink height <= 35 mm; heat sink price + fan price <= 12.

Heat sink catalog:
  HS-1: Rsa = 11.68 / 5.84 / 4.09 / 2.92 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 15 mm, price 2.26
  HS-2: Rsa = 7.78 / 3.89 / 2.72 / 1.95 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 25 mm, price 4.48
  HS-3: Rsa = 5.35 / 2.53 / 1.75 / 1.26 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 35 mm, price 6.86
  HS-4: Rsa = 3.7 / 1.75 / 1.22 / 0.88 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 45 mm, price 12.32
  HS-5: Rsa = 2.53 / 1.17 / 0.83 / 0.58 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 60 mm, price 16.20
  HS-6: Rsa = 1.75 / 0.83 / 0.58 / 0.44 C/W at 0 / 1 / 2 / 4 m/s, height 80 mm, price 26.10

Fan catalog (or use no fan):
  FAN-A (40x40x10 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 29.2], [7.3, 17.5], [11.7, 8.8], [14.6, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 28 dBA, price 2.76
  FAN-B (60x60x25 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 43.8], [19.5, 26.3], [31.1, 13.1], [38.9, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 32 dBA, price 5.40
  FAN-C (80x80x25 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 38.9], [34.1, 23.4], [54.5, 11.7], [68.1, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 30 dBA, price 7.20
  FAN-D (80x80x38 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 87.6], [53.5, 52.5], [85.6, 26.3], [107.0, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 42 dBA, price 14.00
  FAN-E (92x92x38 mm): static pressure vs flow points [[0, 107.0], [77.8, 64.2], [124.5, 32.1], [155.7, 0]] (m3/h, Pa), 46 dBA, price 18.24

Any design satisfying every constraint passes. Return {"fsw_hz": <number>, "heatsink": "<id>", "fan": "<id>" or null}.
